rows.label: qst650611_msg0001
rows.name:
Rose?
That would be me, but[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0002
rows.name: What?!

rows.label: qst650611_msg0003
rows.name:
No, no. We're looking for a girl
about the same age and build
as M.O.M.O. here.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0004
rows.name: Oh, is that so?

rows.label: qst650611_msg0005
rows.name:
But I'm the only Rose
in this city.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0006
rows.name:
That can't be[ML:Dash ]
Lazaro-san clearly[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0007
rows.name: Lazaro?!

rows.label: qst650611_msg0008
rows.name: You met my father?! Where?!

rows.label: qst650611_msg0009
rows.name:
So you really are
Lazaro-san's[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0010
rows.name: His daughter! His real daughter!

rows.label: qst650611_msg0011
rows.name:
Please, tell me!
My father has been missing
for eight years[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0012
rows.name: Eight years?!

rows.label: qst650611_msg0013
rows.name: What the heck is going on?!

rows.label: qst650611_msg0014
rows.name:
Um, we met Lazaro-san
in Invidia.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0015
rows.name:
He asked us to deliver a doll
to you, Rose-san[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0016
rows.name: Oh, there's no mistake.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0017
rows.name: This is a doll my father made[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0018
rows.name:
Please, tell me.
Where in Invidia did you meet him?

rows.label: qst650611_msg0019
rows.name: Is he still there?

rows.label: qst650611_msg0020
rows.name:
Well, if you're that worried,
why not go and see him?

rows.label: qst650611_msg0021
rows.name: Yeah! We can take you there.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0022
rows.name: Oh, if only I could[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0023
rows.name:
Sounds like there's something
keeping you here.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0024
rows.name: Would you mind telling us about it?

rows.label: qst650611_msg0025
rows.name: But this is my[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0026
rows.name:
Old man Lazaro said
he couldn't face his daughter, mo.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0027
rows.name:
But he really wanted to see her!
He looked so lonely, mo!

rows.label: qst650611_msg0028
rows.name:
So she should go
and see him herself, mo!

rows.label: qst650611_msg0029
rows.name: You're very kind, Tora-san.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0030
rows.name: Ahem, mo!

rows.label: qst650611_msg0031
rows.name:
Tora has people all over
he can't show his face to,

rows.label: qst650611_msg0032
rows.name:
so Tora knows how
the old man feels, mo!

rows.label: qst650611_msg0033
rows.name: That's nothing to be proud of, mo.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0034
rows.name: Um, the thing is[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0035
rows.name: I see[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0036
rows.name:
So Rose-san is the one
making the inn's signature dish now.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0037
rows.name: That's right.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0038
rows.name:
If I go all the way to Invidia,
we'll run out of curry
made with Linka Honey[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0039
rows.name:
The innkeeper took care of me
since Dad disappeared.
I can't trouble him[ML:Dash ] I[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0040
rows.name: What do you think, Homura?

rows.label: qst650611_msg0041
rows.name:
Then perhaps you could make enough
curry ahead of time to last through
the trip to Invidia and back.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0042
rows.name:
I can't[ML:Dash ] Linka Honey is rare,
and we only get a little at a time.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0043
rows.name:
Lately, even those deliveries
have been unreliable[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0044
rows.name: Leave that part to us!

rows.label: qst650611_msg0045
rows.name: Besides[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0046
rows.name:
Curry made ahead of time
wouldn't last through that trip,
and it would lose its flavor[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0047
rows.name:
Actually, heating it slowly
at a low temperature
can extend its shelf life a lot.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0048
rows.name:
But keeping the heat
that precise[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0049
rows.name:
I think I can help with that.
Please leave it to me.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0050
rows.name:
That's Homura for you!
An expert at controlling heat!

rows.label: qst650611_msg0051
rows.name:
Then all that remains is for us
to find a large supply
of Linka Honey.

rows.label: qst650611_msg0052
rows.name:
Um, are you sure
you want to do all this[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0053
rows.name: Of course!

rows.label: qst650611_msg0054
rows.name:
First, tell us about
the delivery route that's
been having trouble!

rows.label: qst650611_msg0055
rows.name:
According to young Rose,
the Linka Honey sent along
this route has stopped arriving[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650611_msg0056
rows.name:
Then we'll investigate
what happened along the way.
